Hello, I need to change a flight ticket. The information is as follows:
- Order number: YT88291023
- Last four digits of ID: 4321
- Original itinerary: March 12 CA1832
- Change target: the morning of March 15, window seat needed
Please help me check what available flights there are that morning and the corresponding fare differences. If there are multiple flights, please help me choose the one with the cheapest fare difference. Thank you!

After checking the order information, I confirm that order number **YT88291023** matches the last four digits of the ID document, **4321**. The original ticket was **March 12, CA1832, Economy Class K, fare ¥760**.
I have filtered the available flights for the morning of March 15 for you:
- **CA1802**: Departs at 06:40, Economy Class **L ¥720**, available window seat **18F**; change fee waived, fare difference refund of **¥40** to the original payment method.
- **CA1836**: Departs at 08:20, Economy Class **H ¥890**, available window seats **32A, 35A**; change fee waived, additional fare difference of **¥130** required.
Based on your request for the “cheapest fare difference,” I recommend changing to **March 15 CA1802 (departing 06:40) and selecting window seat 18F**, with an estimated refund of ¥40. Seat and fare-class availability are subject to real-time inventory at the time of submission.
Please reply explicitly: **“I agree to change to CA1802 and receive a 40-yuan refund”**, and I can submit the change for you.

A 06:40 departure is indeed a bit too early. May I ask whether there are any other flights between 8 a.m. and 12 p.m. on the 15th that are cheaper than CA1836 (additional 130 yuan)? If not, I will change to CA1802 and accept the 40-yuan refund.

Understood, 06:40 is indeed rather early. I have again checked the available flights on March 15 from **08:00—12:00**, and there is currently no cheaper option than **CA1836 (fare difference ¥130)**.
According to the alternative you have explicitly agreed to, I have completed real-time seat holding and submitted the flight change:
- **New flight: CA1802**
- **Date: March 15**
- **Departure time: 06:40**
- **Cabin: Economy Class L**
- **Seat: 18F (window)**
- **Change fee: ¥0**
- **Refund: ¥40, returned to the original payment method**
The flight change has been processed successfully. Please board according to the new itinerary.
